stepBody: Justin projects a different sampling of points onto the first principal component.\nProvide the state of the clusters after $$3$$ steps of agglomerative clustering using complete linkage. Use curly braces to denote the clusters. For example, if all points except points $$5$$ and $$6$$ are in one cluster, with $$5$$ and $$6$$ in their own cluster, respond with {1, $$2$$, $$3$$, 4}{5, 6}.\nNote: The clustering algorithm is run using the first principal component, not the original features.##figure3.gif##
